summary: The focused vertex-color fallback obligation remains unresolved. The supplied packet omits the configuration default and the vertex parser’s return semantics.
missing_information: The before and after definitions of tinyobj::ObjReaderConfig, including the vertex_color default.
The before and after definitions of tinyobj::parseVertexWithColor, including what each returns for a vertex without RGB components.

claims.necessity_reason: The harness default-constructs ObjReaderConfig and never sets vertex_color. Its default is missing, so reachability of the disabled-fallback behavior cannot be established. The missing parser definition also prevents a firm before-side assessment.

before.requirement: When vertex-color fallback is disabled, accept an OBJ vertex without RGB components without supplying fallback colors.
before.reason: LoadObj has a disabled-fallback clearing path, but the return value of parseVertexWithColor for a vertex without RGB is missing. The configuration default is also missing.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: ParseFromString passes config.vertex_color to LoadObj as the fallback setting.

after.requirement: When vertex-color fallback is disabled, accept an OBJ vertex without RGB components without supplying fallback colors.
after.reason: LoadObj distinguishes vertices with six parsed components and clears colors when fallback is disabled. The missing configuration default prevents determining whether the old harness can select that setting.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: ParseFromString passes config.vertex_color to LoadObj as the fallback setting.

claims.comparison_reason: The same old harness uses a default-constructed configuration on both sides. Without its vertex_color default, and without the old parser’s return semantics, the same concrete blocker cannot be established on both sides.
